hooks.command: K="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/context-db/bin/kit_profile.py"; L="$(python3 "$K" scratch 2>/dev/null)/hooks.log"; if [ -n "${CLAUDE_ENV_FILE:-}" ] && ! grep -qF '# ai-baton session-env' "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE" 2>/dev/null; then { echo '# ai-baton session-env'; python3 "$K" session-env; } >> "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE" 2>>"$L" || echo "ai-baton: session-env failed writing to $CLAUDE_ENV_FILE - see $L"; fi; python3 "$K" workspace-rules 2>>"$L" || echo "ai-baton: the SessionStart hook could not load WORKSPACE.md (kit_profile.py workspace-rules failed) - the always-on rules are missing from this session; run /kit-health"; exit 0
